core_obligations: Reduce to the local statement: by the stalkwise criterion for universal injectivity it suffices to prove the statement after localising at a prime of the intermediate algebra mapping to a prime of the base (proof lines 1925-1930).
Apply the local version of the statement to the resulting local ring maps and the localised module (proof lines 1931-1934).
proof_roadmap: Stalkwise reduction to a local statement (proof lines 1925-1930).
Application of the local version (proof lines 1931-1934).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for the map from a flat finitely presented module to its base change along a flat ring map to be universally injective, namely that the image of the spectra contains all the relevant associated primes of the fibres (statement lines 1906-1923, tag 05DA-adjacent). The proof reduces the statement to its localised version using the stalkwise criterion for universal injectivity and then applies the local statement. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
